entities.summary: Rosanna María Assunta Costa Costa is a Chilean economist, academic, and researcher. She currently serves as the Governor of the Central Bank of Chile and previously held the position of head of the Ministry of Finance's Budget Office during Sebastián Piñera's first presidency from 2010 to 2014.
